encoded: Mmm, puff the map: fmp ppm pf mmmp fffp!
generator_cmd: hand-written decoy line (m/p/f letters but runs not multiples of 3: not Kenny output)
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | python3 -c "import re,sys; t=sys.stdin.read(); print(re.sub(r\"[mpfMPF]{3}\", lambda m: (lambda n: chr(65+n) if m.group()[0].isupper() else chr(97+n))(int(m.group().lower().translate(str.maketrans(\"mpf\",\"012\")),3)), t), end=\"\")"  # the regex reader turns stray triplets into junk: not the sentence
